title: realtime.live_batch
description: realtime.is_live for many users in one round trip: {"user_ids": [...], "family": "..."?} -> {"users": {user_id: {"live", "sessions", "last_seen"}}}. EVERY id supplied comes back, including one nobody has ever seen (as the offline snapshot) rather than being omitted: the caller is holding that id for a reason and must be told the answer, not left to infer it from an absence. Capped at 100 ids — this is the read a notifier makes before fanning out to a group, not a way to enumerate the fleet.

user_ids.description: Users to answer for. Every id supplied appears in the answer.

family.description: Stream family to count, i.e. the module segment of the stream key. Absent means every family.
